b31c526e-c00a-4acd-9528-023207a8237e.code:
def calculatePatientAge(self):
    birth = self.patient.birthDate
    had_birthday = (self.explorationDate.month, self.explorationDate.day) >= (birth.month, birth.day)
    self.patientAge = self.explorationDate.year - birth.year - (0 if had_birthday else 1)
    return self.patientAge
